d:
Diwali par banayein Jodhpur wali Mawa Kachori — bina kadhai, appe pan mein!
2 cup maida se 25 mini Rajasthani Mawa Kachori — bina belan, kam oil mein.
mava kachauri ka sopht do aur sahi moyan
jodhpuri mava bharavan aur khushbudar masala
appe mold men kam tel men sekne ki trik
chashni, vark aur draee phrut se sajavat
Comment karein — aapne Mawa Kachori kahan khayi, ya ghar par banayi?
